# Retrieval: named indexes

<!-- generated by `mcphost gen-docs` from `index::IndexSourceKind`; do not edit by hand -->

`host.index.create {name, sources[], chunking?}` registers a named index and returns at once; the background indexer chunks every source into one chunk table with byte offsets. `host.index.status {name}` reports `chunks`, `pending`, `lag_seconds` and per-source counts.

## Source kinds

<!-- kinds:start -->
- `doc`: documents whose name starts with `prefix`
- `table`: the text `columns` of a `table`, one item per row
- `url`: one public http(s) `url`, up to 2 MiB
<!-- kinds:end -->

An unknown `kind` is refused `args_invalid` with the message `source kind must be one of: doc, table, url`.

## Limits

`host.quickstart` `limits.plan` carries `index_max` (indexes per tenant, refused `quota_index_max`) and `index_chunks_max` (chunks per tenant; a build past it truncates the source and sets `last_error: "quota_index_chunks_max"`).
